concept: A sustainable eco community; energy calculator.

shots.title: Hero
shots.section: Home hero, full screen behind the headline
shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of eco houses with solar roofs among orchards in Sharjah. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: natural green photography, 35mm; colour palette of green, timber, white, sky. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
